title: Implement agent worktree verification helpers
description: Objective: update AGENTS.md, add PowerShell helper scripts, and add npm wrappers for the approved agent worktree verification workflow. Files: AGENTS.md, scripts/agent-preflight-main.ps1, scripts/verify-current-worktree.ps1, package.json, and focused policy tests if needed. TDD: add/update policy tests first to assert package script wiring and AGENTS.md/Biome invariants, then implement scripts/docs/package updates, then run focused and full verification.
design: Use existing root package scripts rather than inventing alternate checks. agent-preflight-main.ps1 only git fetches origin main and reports FETCH_HEAD/base information. verify-current-worktree.ps1 resolves git root, Set-Location to it, prints root, then runs npm run format, npm run check, npm run typecheck, npm run test with fail-fast PowerShell behavior. Do not change biome.json .worktrees exclusion.
acceptance_criteria: Focused policy tests cover package scripts and AGENTS.md workflow text; scripts exist and fail fast; npm wrappers work; Biome .worktrees exclusion remains; parent preflight script succeeds from parent; verify script succeeds from linked worktree root; full repo verification passes.
notes: Debug evidence: scripts/verify-current-worktree.ps1 correctly resolved git root to D:/src/loreweaver/.worktrees/loreweaver-ij1-1, but npm run format failed because Biome processed 0 files: the explicit biome.json files.includes entry !**/.worktrees excludes the linked worktree path even when run from that worktree root. Temporary config test removing only !**/.worktrees caused Biome to scan 235 files, confirming the exclusion is the root cause; temp config must be excluded from its own scan.
close_reason: Implemented AGENTS.md workflow guidance, PowerShell helper scripts, npm wrappers, and policy tests; verification recorded on bead, including linked-worktree full helper verification passing with Dolt absent skip path.
